title: Realistic, Investigative, and Artistic activity signals
reader_copy: This result places hands-on work, inquiry, and expression alongside one another as activity signals to explore. Try small tasks before drawing wider conclusions; it does not determine personality, ability, job fit, or a career.
experiment: Try one bounded task with a practical step, an evidence-checking step, and an expressive step; record interest, friction, and conditions.
